title: BuildSpec
description: Product-facing emission consumed by ES-L DSP engine. CLEAN-ONLY by construction: black-box measurement + public DSP literature + own voicing. REF (disasm/source-derived) facts are structurally forbidden — a stage carries behavior_targets to MATCH, never imported formulas. A BuildSpec lacking provenance_gate:CLEAN_ONLY is rejected by the engine.

items.comment: No 'formula'/'provenance' keys allowed — REF cannot enter a BuildSpec. Behaviour is specified as targets to measure/match, and every stage MUST carry a null_test that verifies the clone against the reference.

null_test.description: build→verify contract: A/B the clone against the reference plugin, require the residual below threshold. Oracle = the easby-decomp FFI/black-box harness.

oracle.description: how reference output is obtained, e.g. 'ffi_harness:ac1_ffi.py' or 'pedalboard:prol2_sysid.py'

signal.description: test signal set, e.g. 'sweep+transients+music', 'isolated peaks', 'dense tone'

threshold_db.description: fail if residual worse (less negative) than this, e.g. -36

literature.description: public DSP references (AES/JAES papers, DAFX, textbooks)

excluded_ref.description: REF items deliberately NOT imported — listed so the firewall decision is auditable
